title: Vesper and the Archive
author: Emrys Vane
blurb: Orsen Hartwell, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
